sourceFiles.evidence: Native pitch envelope and immediate fixed-amplitude sine vibrato
Pitch envelope/vibrato modify AudioBufferSourceNode.detune, base playbackRate maps sample pitch
ADSR minima and onceEnded overwriting onended
vibmod modulation targets vib_gain.gain in cents

limitations: Every note triggers a picked sample; no continuous finger-contact slide recording
Fixed eighth-note subdivision dominates the ostinato
Same clip/release on each voice causes unnatural same-string tail overlap
No authored long-note vibrato or phrase-ending pitch gestures
Sample layer choice and gain do not consistently follow downstroke/upstroke accents

penv.pcurve: 0 linear, 1 exponential; use linear for signed cents
penv.warning: Pitch envelope returns to min after holdEnd, causing a downward/upward release tail. Custom slide avoids it.

vib.delayedOnset: No native vibdelay; custom wrapper is required for true delay

nativeAPI.clip: event gate multiplier, not portamento or sample legato
nativeAPI.release: seconds after gate; cannot encode physical same-string fingering by itself

fields.slideFrom: relative semitones at onset; -2 glides upward to target
fields.vib: Hz, only set on selected long notes
fields.vibattack: seconds to linearly reach depth, recommended .12-.22

extensions.staticCurve: slideFrom*100*(1-smoothstep(t/slideTime)) + pickCents*(1-smoothstep(t/pickDecay)); returns to exactly 0 and holds there
extensions.curveSampling: 1 kHz control curve, linear interpolation by WebAudio, maximum4097 points
extensions.cleanup: addEventListener(ended,{once:true}) preserves base onended; stops/disconnects oscillator and gain when last source ends; handle and stop remain owned by base sampler

musicalConstraints: Use one guitar-string assignment per fretted voice; end the prior same-string note before another fretted note, while genuine open strings may ring.
Standard tuning MIDI low-to-high = [40,45,50,55,59,64]; constrain each event to plausible 0..20 fret range and chords to <=6 unique strings.
Short slides generally move 1-2 semitones on the same string. Do not apply a whole-chord pitch ramp, which sounds like a synth wheel.
Pickups can use soft layers and short gates; strong downstrokes use normal layers. Rotate RR independently of velocity level.
Apply vibrato only to selected sustained phrase ends, not to every eighth note. Pitch modulation cannot manufacture missing fret/noise articulations.
Keep strong drum anchors; use coherent 2-8 ms timing offsets for a phrase, not independent full-range randomness on every hit.
A sample retrigger with short attack is not true hammer-on/pull-off. Simulate sparingly with quieter/softer articulations and acknowledge this limit.
